This is the first Release Candidate of version 0.10. What is updated is not final and may be changed at any point. Bugs are expected until everything is ironed out and tested, we apologise for any inconveniences in this time.

10 NEW LEVELS!

Overhaul of the graphical interface
- Major changes to the UI, and HUD
- Main Menu news and updates to the game

Animated Skins

48 Skins have been added to the lineup for a total of 106 possible skins you can buy in the Marble Store. For the next few days the Roster will feature all new skins for you to buy. Get saving!

- Right Mouse Button secondary jump
This is for users with a different keyboard layout to the standard QWERTY. In the next update will will look into key-rebinds, but for now users who were having issues controlling the ball and jumping can use the Arrow keys + the Mouse for full control.

- Bug fixes

- Forced windowed
Now forcing new users into windowed mode to prevent fullscreen making it impossible to change settings depending on resolution

- Slight changes to jump mechanics
We have improved the allowance of jumps when jumping from an edge of a platform. Previously if your ball was slightly over the edge, you were unable to jump. The tolerance for this has been increase and should allow for more precise platforming. This will not affect physics or level times in any way.

notes.notes:
HOTFIX v0.06-RC4 - 02/19/2018

We have pushed out an update in an attempt to address the crashing/controls issues recently reported, and some changes to balance in leaderboard scores. Please restart Steam if you haven't got the update yet!


- Leaderboard changes

Global rank has been altered slightly to make it easier to see exactly who you're competing against even if you're not going for rank 1. Anyone with previous ranked scores have been adjusted for this.

notes.title: MARBLE STORE!! PATCH NOTES v0.06-RC3 - 15/02/2018
notes.notes:
0.06-RC3 will be out for testing within the hour! Over the past few weeks we have been working on major database upgrades, a marble skin store, and aditional ranking leaderboards for players to compete globally. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146653/f19a30969310e470e044bb0a10cadd52d1fda191.jpg

Behind the scenes database upgrades
We are now tracking a variety of user stats which will be accesible in the Extras Leaderboards menu. Global Rank, Level, Gems, Distance and Deaths can be compared with other users. 

Please be aware that this is the first live test of the new database systems, and you may run into issues. We apologize for any inconveniences, and ask you submit any bug reports to our Steam Community Forums.

- How do Global Ranks work?

Your global rank is calculated based on your skill level and how much you play the game. Everyone will start from 0, it will be quick to climb up the ranks if you are committed enough, but also not too discouraging for newer players who start at a skill disadvantage.

- Marble Store/Skin Roster
Playing the game will reward you with Gems to spend in the Skin Store. Each day 8 different skins will be up for sale in the store. You can earn gems by leveling up and completing levels.

There are 58 skins total; common, uncommon and rare. Each day the roster will feature 4 commons, 3 uncommons and 1 rare skin, all with different prices. 

Once you have bought these skins they can be accessed and applied at anytime in the Inventory menu. Can you collect them all?


- Server upgrades
You should never have any downtime which was a rare issue before.

A long with this, times and stats will never be lost again as the new systems allow complete control and flexability. With this comes increases to cheat-detection, we can now properly ban offending users from competing in any of the leaderboards!

- Two New Levels!

We are now at 82 total levels! 22 more since the first release! Extended Bunny and Rolling Hills can be found in the Bonus stage selection screen.

- Join the Discord!
Some of our players have set up a community Discord channel! Click the link below to join.
https://discord.gg/BjY5zNm

Thanks!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES v0.06-RC1 - 01/27/2018
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES v0.06-RC1 - 01/27/2018

This is our first release candidate update for public beta testing of the new physics system.

Whats New:

- Physics improvements

Don't worry about your already completed times! This new physics system is exactly the same as the old, but should fix major "bounce glitch" issues. 

- 2 New User Levels

Gemsweeper by Jazzek & Courage by le mems


What does RC mean?

We originally planned to have a whole new global ranking system in the v0.05 update, but because of issues that came up It was post-poned. Future v0.06RC updates will begin rolling out some of these new features for testing, so please be aware that any stats(besides level leaderboards) may be reset at any point.

Full release of v0.06 will feature global ranking, full stat tracking, new gem currency, and more. We don't have a confirmed ETA for this update, but stay tuned!

- Collection level category

5 new levels that feature dozens of gems for you to collect. These extremely large maps have many different routes for you to figure out, as well as being the foundations for maps that will be used for multiplayer later this year.

- Increased collision range of Gems.

notes.title: 2018 IS COMING! PATCH NOTES v0.04 - 12/30/2017
notes.notes:
2018 is almost here, and to celebrate v0.04 of Marble Skies is here!

PATCH NOTES v0.04 - 12/30/2017

- New Year themed menu!
- Random marble skins(testing) 
- Q to change your skin at any time
- Various leaderboard tweaks
- Best times are now retrieved from leaderboard database to avoid local save issues

- Level touch-ups
Beginner Levels: 7, 8, 11, 13
Intermediate: 5, 11, 14, 20
Advanced: 3, 6, 7, 14, 16, 19, 20

All these levels feature fixes to the smoothness of curves, and some extra decorations. Changes will not have any affect on leaderboard times.

- Beginner level 8 redesign
Half Pipe altered to help casual players complete easier. New ramps enable users to skip the rocket jump, and take a long ramp to the top.

- Intermediate level 14 redesign
Bunny Hopping II start altered as the casual method was rarely played.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES v0.035 - 12/29/2017
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES v0.035 - 12/29/2017

Small update to leaderboard plugin, how the leaderboards works and powerup exploit fixes.

- Leaderboard now shows times to the nearest 3rd decimal place. This should reduce confusion as to who has the best times when all are similar.
- Leaderboard now ranks users past 50. Testing needed.
- Leaderboard "Show Me" and "Show Top" buttons added
- Powerup timer issue fixed. Quick restarts now reset the respawn timers. 
- Intermediate level 19 renamed to "Depths Below"
- Any times suspected of previous exploit uses have been removed. 

Make sure to check out our new External Level Creation guide if you would like to start making levels!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1247141752
